import numpy as np
# additive test: F(t) via binned basis + polynomial in P
K=20
edges=np.linspace(t.min(),t.max()+1e-9,K+1)
B=np.array([(t>=edges[i])&(t<edges[i+1]) for i in range(K)]).T.astype(float)
Pb=np.array([P**k for k in range(0,6)]).T
X=np.hstack([B,Pb[:,1:]])
c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
r=X@c-dP_dt
print('additive NMSE',np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt))
print('G coeffs',np.round(c[K:],4))
print('F',np.round(c[:K],2))
# multiplicative check: interaction P*F(t)
X2=np.hstack([B,B*P[:,None],Pb[:,2:]])
c2=np.linalg.lstsq(X2,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
